_readme: Legacy group list for scripts/fb-group-commenter.js's ORIGINAL scan-and-comment
mode (loadGroups()). NOT used by that file's active production path --
fb-group-commenter.js's only path actually run in production today is
--tc-reply-queue (drains tc_discovery_responses, wired from
run-tc-discovery-harvest.cmd); that path never reads this file. Real active
target-group discovery now lives in scripts/comment-hunt-groups.json, driven by
scripts/fb-comment-hunt-daily.js.
AUDIT (Carter, 2026-09-16): none of these 20 entries have ever been confirmed
against a live Facebook session as far as any record in this repo shows -- no
hunt log, no seen-file, no regression fixture references any of them. They were
added in a single commit (e6f5c1e3, 'load groups from local JSON file') without
documented verification. Per Heath's instruction: kept, not deleted, and marked
existence_verified=false across the board rather than silently assumed real --
this is exactly the failure mode that let 'Boerne Real Estate' and 'Real Estate
in Austin TX' (real audit findings the same day, neither of which happens to be
in this file) go unnoticed as fictional group names.
SCHEMA (same as scripts/comment-hunt-groups.json, see that file's _readme for the
full field explanation): existence_verified / existence_verified_date,
acting_identity ('page' | 'personal' | 'unverified'), identity_membership_verified,
requires_admin_approval, verification_note.
scripts/_lib/group-resolvability-check.js refuses any entry here where
existence_verified isn't true -- since that's every entry today, loadGroups()
in fb-group-commenter.js will report all 20 as unresolved and return an empty
resolvable list until someone actually re-verifies a group live and flips its flag.
